entries.definition: characteristic of false pride; having an exaggerated sense of self-importance

entries.definition: ill-mannered and coarse and contemptible in behavior or appearance

entries.definition: having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value

entries.definition: having or showing great eagerness or enthusiasm

entries.definition: bright and pleasant; promoting a feeling of cheer

entries.label: negative

entries.definition: poor enough to need help from others

entries.label: negative

entries.label: negative

entries.label: negative

entries.label: negative

entries.label: negative

entries.definition: appealing to the emotions as well as the eye

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Severe and formal - badness spoken of as if it were an outrage.

entries.definition: slow to learn or understand; lacking intellectual acuity
entries.label: negative

entries.definition: showing patient and unruffled self-control and restraint under adversity; slow to retaliate or express resentment

entries.label: negative

entries.label: negative

entries.definition: naive and easily deceived or tricked

entries.definition: designed to deceive or mislead either deliberately or inadvertently

entries.definition: not having enough money to pay for necessities

entries.label: negative

entries.definition: deceptive or fraudulent; disposed to cheat or defraud or deceive

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Order was lost rather than never present - the pieces are all still there.

entries.definition: offensively self-assured or given to exercising usually unwarranted power

entries.definition: openly distrustful and unwilling to confide

entries.definition: pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life

entries.definition: limp and soiled as if dragged in the mud

entries.label: negative

entries.label: neutral

entries.definition: pleasing in appearance especially by reason of conformity to ideals of form and proportion

entries.label: negative

entries.definition: at an advanced stage of erosion (pronounced as one syllable)
entries.label: neutral

entries.definition: marked by excessive complacency or self-satisfaction
entries.label: negative

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The adverb of *chirpy*: British and small-scale, and grating if the hearer is not cheerful too.

entries.definition: petty or reluctant in giving or spending
entries.label: negative

entries.definition: express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness
entries.label: negative

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Cleverness that sparkles in company.
examples: a play full of scintillating dialogue

entries.label: negative

examples: a fraudulent scheme to escape paying taxes

entries.definition: with a lack of courage and determination
entries.label: negative

entries.label: negative

entries.definition: bright and pleasant; promoting a feeling of cheer

entries.definition: marked by refinement in taste and manners
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Refinement praised, but primly - the word can carry a faintly pitying edge, as in 'shabby-genteel'.

entries.label: neutral

entries.label: negative

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Force without proportion - more was applied than the thing needed.
examples: incensed at the government's heavy-handed economic policies

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Skill in deceiving, and the skill is half admired - the disapproval is real but not total.
examples: cunning men often pass for wise

entries.definition: marked by or showing unaffected simplicity and lack of guile or worldly experience
entries.label: negative

examples: a teenager's naive ignorance of life
the naive assumption that things can only get better

entries.definition: characterized by quickness and ease in learning
entries.label: positive

examples: some children are brighter in one subject than another
a bright student who asks good questions

entries.definition: characterized by kindness and warm courtesy especially of a king to his subjects
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Courtesy from a position of advantage; graciousness costs the giver nothing.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Points at whoever caused it - the anger is presented as a reasonable response.

entries.definition: showing or motivated by sympathy and understanding and generosity
entries.label: positive

examples: was charitable in his opinions of others

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Chivalrous courage - noble and old-fashioned.
examples: put up a gallant resistance to the attackers

entries.definition: pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life

examples: He died at home, surrounded by his family.

entries.definition: humble in spirit or manner; suggesting retiring mildness or even cowed submissiveness

entries.definition: (used of persons and their behavior) cultivated and genteel

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Pure contempt - the invented, mincing sound does the sneering.

entries.definition: having or showing feelings of unwarranted importance out of overbearing pride

entries.definition: noisy like the sound of a bee

entries.label: negative

entries.label: neutral

entries.label: positive

entries.definition: not pretended; sincerely felt or expressed

entries.definition: pleasing in appearance especially by reason of conformity to ideals of form and proportion

entries.definition: worn or shabby from overuse or (of pages) from having corners turned down
